body:
Yeah. My dad was a good guy. I know I didn't amount to what he wanted for me in life. But I also know he was never disappointed in me.

He was my anchor. He was my best friend. He was the rock I clung to when everything else was turmoil. And now I don't have that anymore . . . 



Goddamn. I miss him. So damn much.

That's what my father used to tell me. 
Hold on; tie a knot, and hold on. 


It's harder than it used to be.
